description: SPL job escrow for agent work, on Solana devnet (Anchor 0.31.1). initialize, create_job, set_budget, fund, submit and complete were verified end-to-end: 1_000_000 units escrowed, the provider received 995_000, a 0.5% fee (5_000) went to the lab treasury, and the vault was emptied. bonding_curve was not deployed.
demonstrationNotice: Sol.College-owned demonstration of darks0l/solagents-programs (programs/agentic-commerce only). The lab tree is branch sol-college-devnet of Blockchains/solagents-programs. The lab only changed declare_id for agentic_commerce to a unique Sol.College devnet program; bonding_curve was not deployed. The hosted IDL is the lab build of the upstream IDL, confirmed by the verifying transactions. The upstream author has not joined Sol.College; acceptance here is by Sol.College, not by the upstream project.

scope: Anchor program correctness on the Solana runtime (initialize, create_job, set_budget, fund, submit, complete)
Frontend reliability of the hosted devnet console at sol.college/dapps/solagents-commerce/
QA: devnet proof of the full job lifecycle, 0.5% fee split, and re-initialize rejection
exclusions: Changes to the upstream repository other than ordinary pull requests
Security disclosure in public (security findings go to private channels)

assignments.title: Exercise an optional hook program on fund/complete
